text:
Diane: Re-requesting review on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 — I addressed the comments about default timeout semantics, added a changelog entry, and synced the README. Please take a look, aiming to merge before tonight's canary.

Diane: Quick summary of changes:
- default timeout logic: `default_request_timeout` now only applies when the request doesn't include an explicit timeout.
- added unit + e2e tests for timeout overrides.
- README: new 'Timeouts' section with examples and caveats.

Omar: skimmed — overall looks solid. one small naming nit: can we make it `default_request_timeout` (explicit about request vs connection)?

Diane: good call, renamed the config and updated docs & tests, pushed a new commit.

Matt: tiny suggestion: include a short YAML config snippet in the README so people copy-paste correctly, e.g.:
```
server:
  default_request_timeout: 30s
```
Also add a note that models can override this per-model in model_config.

Diane: added the snippet and the per-model override note.

Jen: left one comment on the added e2e test — the assertion is flaky when CI is under load. can you switch to `await waitForCondition(() => ...)` instead of a fixed sleep?

Diane: swapped the sleep for waitForCondition and re-ran CI. all checks passed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/actions/runs/123456789

deploy-bot: Canary slot available tonight at 02:00 UTC if merged by 01:00 UTC :calendar:

Omar: LGTM from me, approving now.

Matt: approved as well.

Diane: thanks everyone — merging after 00:45 UTC to hit the deploy window. ping here if anything breaks and I'll roll back immediately.
